'''Fortuna Spaceport''' was a small [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in [[Fortuna City]] on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. Only a few [[Transport/Legends|transports]] were handled by the passenger and cargo terminals, and it handled [[trans-oceanic shuttle]]s traveling to the southern continent. [[Edan Spaceways]], [[Thrust-Thru Flights]], and [[Fortuna Gifts]] were based in the spaceport.
